captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera speedlight flash accessory. It features a tall, curved black control body with an integrated rear LCD screen and a series of four vertically stacked button controls on the side. The main body is mounted on a wide gray hot-shoe stand, while the top houses a cylindrical neck supporting a U-shaped yoke. The forward-facing rectangular flash head with a light-tan diffuser lens sits between the yoke arms, allowing it to tilt vertically, while the entire neck and head assembly can pan horizontally relative to the main body.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional camera speedlight flash as an articulated model. The assembly should feature a tall, rounded black body with a rear screen and side control buttons sitting on a gray mounting foot, a neck that swivels horizontally, and a rectangular flash head with a light-tan diffuser lens that tilts vertically between two yoke arms.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate using a thin box and a smaller nested box subtracted to form the hot-shoe mount. Build the main body with a rounded rectangular extrusion, filleting the vertical edges, and add a recessed box for the rear screen and four small extruded side buttons. Create the neck using a cylinder that swivels via a revolute joint. Build the yoke using a horizontal box and two vertical arm boxes, and mount the rectangular flash head (composed of a main box, a thin bezel, and a colored lens insert) between the arms using a horizontal revolute joint to enable pitching motion.
